investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Orbis Cloud Storage; Platform: on-premises Ceph cluster providing block storage to a KVM virtual machine platform; storage network 10.4.0.0/16, switch management network 10.0.254.0/24; one top-of-rack switch pair per rack; Consumers: block-volume-api and the hypervisor fleet (vm-agent, rbd clients); Change management: CHG- (software/storage) and NET- (network) identifiers.
